metadata.title: The ELM Survey. I. A Complete Sample of Extremely Low Mass White Dwarfs

notes: No eligible stars. The paper studies extremely low-mass white dwarfs and their binary companions and gives disk/halo kinematic classifications, but it does not identify any star as a Galactic unbound candidate or establish that any satisfies an unbound criterion (T:p9-b1; T:p15-b2).
